ValidationRule.description: MR-119 1b.3: Voided, Accepted and Denied quotes are final – no edits, re-submission or status change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Voided"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Accepted"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Denied")), OR(ISCHANGED(Status), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(ExpirationDate), ISCHANGED(RLM_TermMonths__c), ISCHANGED(MB_Billing_Frequency__c), ISCHANGED(Coupon_Code__c), ISCHANGED(Pricebook2Id)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote is final (Voided, Accepted or Denied) and can't be changed. Clone it to make a new quote.
